name: Fine-Grained Tracker
description: Tracks lineage, status, and audit metadata for individual records at row-level granularity through a pipeline. Persists per-record state transitions to enable debugging, replay, and SLA monitoring.
when_to_use: Each record needs traceable history across pipeline stages
SLA monitoring requires per-record latency visibility
Audit and replay are regulatory requirements
drawbacks: Schema coupling between tracker and payload

typescript.description: Per-record trace store with history scan.
